messages:
Lucy Chen: Hey team — trying to pull metrics + traces for serving-edge in east-3. Looking for a service-overview dashboard and the model-health view. Tried the grafana links I had and got 403. Any shortlinks or debugging tips? I have request id req_9b2f I want to trace

Ben Rao: Short answer: you need Grafana Viewer role. Dashboards — service overview: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/7sEr-service-overview-serving-edge and model health: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/3kLm-model-health (filter region=east-3). If you get 403 it's an org/role issue.

Ben Rao: You can request via infra self-serve: https://redwood.internal/infra-access -> select "Grafana Viewer" + team 'team-data'. If you want temporary access now I can ask infra to add you to grafana-viewers for 8h. @infra-oncall can we grant a short-lived viewer?

infra-oncall (SRE): @Ben Rao Yep — will open a temp-grant. Filing ticket INC-10248. If you want longer than 8h say so.

Kai Patel: For traces, try Jaeger first: https://traces.redwood.internal/search?traceID=req_9b2f . If traceID lookup fails, you can search logs in Loki with this query to find span/log lines:
```loki
{app="serving-edge",region="east-3"} |= "req_9b2f"
```
That should give you the pod/host + span id to jump into Jaeger.

sre-bot: deploy completed for serving-edge :white_check_mark: commit abc123 — no infra regressions detected.

Lucy Chen: Thanks. I tried infra-access and hit a 403 on that page too (says "org admin approval required"). Ticket INC-10248 is open but notes approver from team-data required. Can someone from team-data approve? My email lucy@redwood.com if needed.

Ben Rao: Pinged Jordan (team-data lead) on the ticket thread. Jordan can approve quickly.

Jordan Li: I approved the request in INC-10248 — can infra-oncall apply the grant? :thumbsup:

infra-oncall (SRE): Done — added Lucy Chen to grafana-viewers until 2024-06-05T18:30Z. You should be able to open the two dashboards now.

Lucy Chen: Confirmed I can view the service overview + model-health and the Jaeger link resolved the trace. All good, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
